name: open-paper-reviewer
description: Review a scientific paper claim by claim: every claim quoted, checked four ways and given a verdict from a fixed rubric, with the review's own citations verified and the model, effort and prompt recorded.

interface.longDescription: Review a scientific paper claim by claim. Every claim is quoted verbatim, checked against the paper's own evidence, the literature, alternative explanations and standard practice, and given a verdict from a fixed rubric. The review's own citations are verified before it is finalized, and the model, reasoning effort and prompt are recorded so results can be compared and reproduced.
defaultPrompt: Review this paper claim by claim
Check whether this preprint's citations support its claims
Do a standard review of this manuscript
